title: The Ancient City Beneath the Fields
short_teaser: Aerial photographs, satellite images, and ground-penetrating tools have revealed buried roads, walls, and settlements beneath modern farmland.
story: Aerial photographs, satellite images, and ground-penetrating tools have revealed buried roads, walls, and settlements beneath modern farmland. New ways of looking can make hidden structures visible without destroying what covers them. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: New ways of looking can make hidden structures visible without destroying what covers them. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist explaining it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three possible explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
